title: Municipal waste

review.classification: Frozen UN June 2025 p. 205 and October 2026 CPC3 row 1936 indicate municipal waste, with HS 3825.10 in the latter. WCO chapter 38 note 4 excludes segregated materials and several specialist wastes. A site-specific household subset requires actual origin and acceptance records.
review.primary_evidence: SPU 2022 plan Chapter 7 Table 7.1 and the 2025 City Final EIS Exhibit 3.11-34 list residential garbage at North alongside commercial loads, self-haul and organics. SPU household guidance distinguishes the diverted and residual streams. The 2020 composition study collected its residential garbage sorting samples at South. It supplies no default North consignment composition.
review.measurement: Keep intrinsic discarded household packaging in the mixture. For the same vehicle adjust matched inbound and outbound measurements for actual non-cargo changes, then subtract only unloaded non-target material and operational containment still present in their difference. Independent arithmetic verified the examples for a cart retained aboard, an unloaded 100 kg container, and a distinct 50 kg rejected fraction with 1,000, 900 and 850 kg accepted respectively. Prior acceptance, transfers and later freight or disposal keep separate cohorts and burdens. The controller also carried the exact archived US mass conversions from the author’s prose into the projected calculation rule in both languages.
review.native_records: Independently retrieved nine conditionally applicable exchange identities plus the rejected employee-amenities Mixed domestic refuse Waste. Thirteen card occurrences in each language bind native flows. Use actual local fuel, packaging and measured compartments. Keep NO distinct from NO2, fossil carbon distinct from biogenic carbon, and odour indications distinct from actual measured releases. The unique household reference Product remains unresolved.
review.readiness: The author corrected possible double tare deduction before the final four-file commit. English and Chinese each contain 34 inventory cards. The independent target check performed 173 checks, skipped none and retained 29 nonblocking warnings. Candidate/authored, Chinese aligned. Actual shipment and provider data, scientific approval and publication remain pending.

sources.role: HS chapter 38 note 4: municipal waste includes relevant mixed household waste; individually segregated materials/articles, industrial waste, pharmaceutical waste and clinical waste are excluded. A narrowly scoped single-family collection excludes commercial, separately collected materials and self-haul even when another part of the broad HS definition might cover them.

Seattle Public Utilities 2022 solid waste plan Chapter 7 facility table specifically lists city-contracted residential garbage at North Transfer Station but also commercial, self-haul and separate organic streams. Actual route and scale records must separate them. Outbound rail container and waste management/transfer service are different functions.

City’s 2025 final environmental impact statement lists North Transfer Station as a transfer site for city-contracted residential garbage; not just self-haul. Require the actual load ticket, route and single-family origin. Keep waste article from collection/transfer service.

2020 residential study’s garbage loads were sampled at South Transfer Station, while recycling samples were taken to North for sorting. Cannot use that citywide garbage composition as measured North Station lot composition. The 2023 residential self-haul study is also a different collection population.
UNSD October 2026 original, CPC3 worksheet row 1936, HS 2022 3825.10. Classification evidence only; retain the original June 2025 frozen coordinate.
